info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Utility Billing Disputes-v5-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Disputes Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive list of disputes related to utility billing. This endpoint is essential for utility companies and their customer service teams to efficiently manage and resolve billing issues reported by customers. By utilizing this API, developers can integrate dispute retrieval functionalities into their applications, streamlining the customer support process. Typical use cases include querying existing billing disputes for a customer, tracking dispute statuses, and facilitating smoother operations within utility management systems.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information regarding billing disputes. Users can query this endpoint to understand the current status of their disputes, including any relevant details such as dates, amounts, and resolution steps.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of a billing dispute. It should contain the necessary parameters to identify and fetch the specific dispute information.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesRequest.description: A request body represented as a string for retrieving billing dispute information.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_200.title: Billing Dispute Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the billing dispute.

resultId.description: The ID of the result for the billing dispute.

state.description: The current state of the billing dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the request.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response structure for retrieving billing dispute information.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the record was created by an automated process.

AuditDetails.description: This schema outlines the audit details related to the billing dispute.

x-processing-time.description: This header indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A value of 0 means the processing time was negligible.
